svg.title: Where Azure CNI Overlay takes its addresses
svg.desc: The node takes its address from snet-aks in vnet-lab; pods take theirs from the overlay range 10.244.0.0/16 and services from 10.0.0.0/16, with cluster DNS at 10.0.0.10, so neither touches the lab's address pool or the gateway's networks, and neither is reachable from outside except through a service. The node goes out through the Standard load balancer kubernetes and its one outbound public IP.
